rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a being that cannot die.

example.english: The immortals in legends are immortal.
example.traditional: 傳說中嘅神仙係不死㗎。
example.jyutping: cyun4 syut3 zung1 ge3 san4 sin1 hai6 bat1 sei2 gaa3

rows.note: Use this especially for people or legendary beings who retain life and youth forever.

example.english: He took an elixir, hoping to become immortal.
example.traditional: 佢食咗仙丹，希望可以長生不老。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sik6 zo2 sin1 daan1 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 coeng4 sang1 bat1 lou5

rows.note: Use this in literary descriptions of words, works, or achievements that will remain memorable forever.

example.english: This work became an immortal classic of cinema.
example.traditional: 呢套作品成為影壇不朽嘅經典。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 zok3 ban2 sing4 wai4 jing2 taan4 bat1 jau2 ge3 ging1 din2
